Name: RAGDOLL_PARAM_ST
Description: Physics settings for the damage ragdoll: how strongly the ragdoll rigid bodies follow the animated pose, and their speed limits.

Fields.Name: Hierarchy Gain
Fields.Description: Lowering it will bring it closer to the original pose, while increasing it will make it squishier.

Fields.Name: Velocity Damping
Fields.Description: The rate at which the ragdoll's movement speed is reduced. When it approaches 0, it returns slowly, and when it approaches 1, it returns suddenly.

Fields.Name: Acceleration Gain
Fields.Description: Adjusts the acceleration of the rigid bodies. Lower values make the movement softer, higher values make it stiffer.

Fields.Name: Velocity Gain
Fields.Description: Adjusts the velocity of the rigid bodies. Lower values make the movement softer, higher values make it stiffer.

Fields.Name: Position Gain
Fields.Description: Adjusts the movement position of the rigid bodies. Lower values make the movement softer, higher values make it stiffer.

Fields.Name: Max Linear Velocity
Fields.Description: Maximum movement speed of the rigid bodies.

Fields.Name: Max Angular Velocity
Fields.Description: Maximum angular velocity of the rigid bodies.

Fields.Name: Snap Gain
Fields.Description: Adjusts how strongly the ragdoll is pulled back towards the original pose. Similar in effect to Position Gain.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: If ON, this part moves during the damage ragdoll.

Fields.Name: Parts Hit Mask No.
Fields.Description: Mask number for this body part. -1: mask disabled.
